agent_explanation: Fast circle hits thin (0.1 wide) wall with high restitution e~0.91. Incoming speed ~38.9 should rebound at ~0.91x, but rebound speed is ~41.34 (vx -41.33), larger than incoming, raising energy from ~814 to ~911.9 with zero controller work. Likely cause: wall-collision impulse/positional-correction over-corrects for a thin box at high speed over many substeps (21-22 per step), adding energy instead of dissipating e fraction.
